text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. 
The time has come to return this to you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? 
The hot springs trip voucher we won at New 
Year's.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And how I have held onto it ever since 
that day?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
All for an auspicious day yet to come. 
So, what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We have run our race to completion. 
Enough to let some of the weight slip from 
our shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Would you not say this is that very 
'auspicious day'?
choice_data_list:
...You're right. Let's unwind and treat 
each other.

...Yeah, let's take time to look after 
each other.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. 
Let us stretch our wings. And then—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Nay, I merely had a thought. 
Since we have been granted such a fine 
opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You may look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text: "Hello, Phalaenopsis-san?"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive me for calling so late. 
Truth be told, there is a matter I wish to 
discuss.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I would like to borrow your counsel. 
...Yes, for the sake of what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —For the future of us all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later, 
I arrived at the inn with Phalaenopsis.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Looking back, we've both 
led such frantic, busy lives.
choice_data_list:
It's been so long since we had a real 
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis had always run at full 
throttle 
to guide the way forward with her back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And I always felt like I was desperately 
striving 
just to keep pace and stand beside her.
choice_data_list:
Still, those days spent running beside you 
are my pride.

Still, the time spent running alongside 
you is my pride.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. 
You would go so far as to call it your 
pride?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet if one runs without pause, their 
spirit will wither. 
Be it human or horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us soak in the waters first. 
We can speak more after.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bathing...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —That was a wonderful bath.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hand Phalaenopsis the drink 
I bought while waiting for her.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
... 
This is—
choice_data_list:
Drinking something too cold isn't good for 
your stomach.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So you held it in your hands while 
waiting?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You truly are something else... 
......
choice_data_list:
For today at least, let me pamper you with 
all I've got.

At least for today, let me pamper you with 
all I've got.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then allow me to return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who said it, were you 
not? 
That we should 'care for each other.'

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Today is an 'auspicious day.' Surely that 
holds true 
for me just as much as it does for you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Now, come here. 
I shall not let you escape.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First, offer your leg to me. 
I shall start by working the tension from 
your calves.
choice_data_list:
Wait, no! If anyone's giving a massage, it 
should be me—

Wait, no! If anyone's giving a massage, it 
should be me—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh? 
Does having me tend to you make you 
uneasy?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I thought as much.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Be at ease. 
Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —I am the flower you brought into bloom.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A heart to cherish, and the hands to 
care... 
they have budded within me as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis's hands gently rest 
upon my ankle.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First, she cradles my ankle, applying 
pressure. 
Then, with her palms, she slowly glides... 
up toward my knee.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Does it feel pleasant?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And then, she presses the Weizhong 
acupoint behind my knee.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. 
It seems true after all—it does wonders 
for those who spend long hours sitting at 
work.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet I do not ask that you endure it. 
Be honest and tell me whenever it hurts.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
For then I might truly blossom into a 
flower 
that can stay even closer by your side.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Now, for the other side.
choice_data_list: Wait, before that! Let's take turns!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Too soon.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We are only halfway through. 
My turn is far from over.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—You would do well to accustom yourself 
now.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, you intend to keep running 
by my side from here on out, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Then—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...it is high time you grew accustomed 
to being the one who is pampered.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No longer should you settle for being a 
'disciple.' 
You must not keep thinking you are only 
meant to serve.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Since we have chosen to walk together, 
we must give and receive devotion in 
kind... 
and entrust ourselves entirely to each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Understood, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I, too, shall cherish you openly and 
proudly.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Phalaenopsis once again 
gently strokes my ankle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under her tender, all-embracing gaze, 
...I quietly surrendered myself to her 
care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a precious moment where I felt 
an irreplaceable bond form 
between Phalaenopsis and myself...
